messages.subject: ctmm spring webinar
parts:
The ctmm spring webinar will take place at the end of May. You can vote on the schedule here:

https://doodle.com/poll/sprchehknhkb9g56?utm_source=poll&utm_medium=link

You can also vote on the content here:

https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/DQQNHRP

As with previous ctmm webinars, you will need to message/email me your Skype username so that I can add you to the webinar group. If you've done this before, then you should still be a group member. "Skype for business" and "Microsoft Teams" are not compatible with Skype's group call feature. There is a 100 participant limit during the webinar. The webinar will be recorded and available in the Skype group for 30 days.

Best,
Chris
